note: Baseline results on the prompt-dev split (3 diagrams with partial GT annotation). Ground-truth edges are sparse; metrics on diagrams without GT are marked null. This file is regenerated by scripts/compare_relation_methods.py.

cv_only.note: No GT edge annotations available for dev diagrams; proximity-only heuristic produces many false positives.

clip_vlm.note: Type-pair rule matching; misses relations between same-type components.

geometry_hough.note: Requires OpenCV and bounding-box annotations; F1=0.581 reported on Sprint 5 full dataset (see docs/sprint5_vit_geometry_report.md).

cv_only.weakness: High false-positive rate; proximity alone is not evidence of a connector.

clip_vlm.strength: Semantically informed; reduces false positives for typed components.
clip_vlm.weakness: Cannot detect connectors not implied by type pairs; ignores actual diagram lines.

geometry_hough.strength: Directly detects connector lines; best single-method F1 on Sprint 5 dataset.
geometry_hough.weakness: Requires clean bounding boxes; arrowhead direction heuristic has ~50% error on ambiguous arrows.

failure_categories: Diagram without bounding-box annotations: geometry method cannot run.
Overlapping components: Hough lines snap to wrong box.
Same-type adjacent components (two services): all three methods produce UNCERTAIN direction.
Dashed connectors: Canny edge threshold misses low-contrast lines.
limitations: Ground-truth edge annotations are sparse; metrics on diagrams without GT are null.
cv_only baseline uses proximity heuristic — not a trained detector.
clip_vlm baseline uses type-pair rules — not a live VLM API call.
Results measured on dev split only; held-out test split not touched.
No result is claimed as final; re-run compare_relation_methods.py with annotated GT to populate metrics.
